blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — With the holiday season approaching, the EcoWaste Coalition has welcomed a Philippine National Police (PNP) directive to step up efforts against illegal firecracker sales, following the group’s report of banned pyrotechnic products being sold on streets and through online platforms. The environmental watchdog said it sought police intervention after raising concerns about the availability of prohibited firecrackers, asking authorities to investigate the trade and act on leads it had gathered.
